handback.title: Required checks, labels and the audit follow settings
handback.summary: The daily audit and its guard judge a repo by its own settings, not by Dokima's own values.
handback.user_story: The audit and filed issues follow a repo's own required checks, label names, colors and merge queue choice.

acceptance_criteria.text: The audit wants the default branch to require exactly the checks named in the required checks setting.

edge_cases.case: The branch rule lacks a check the settings add, so the audit names it.

acceptance_criteria.text: With the merge queue turned off in a repo's settings, the Setup issue never mentions a merge queue.

edge_cases.case: GitHub refuses to list the repo's rulesets while the queue is off.

acceptance_criteria.text: The audit looks for each of Dokima's labels under its name in the labels setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: `labels: {plan: plan, work: work, autopilot: autopilot, filed: filed-by-dokima}`

edge_cases.case: The repo still holds only the old label name, so the renamed one is missing.

acceptance_criteria.text: The daily audit no longer flags a label color that matches the repo's settings.

edge_cases.case: The label keeps the shipped color while the settings name another.

acceptance_criteria.text: The daily audit no longer flags a board pill color that matches the repo's settings.

edge_cases.case: The pill keeps the shipped color while the settings name another.

acceptance_criteria.text: The settings guard no longer flags a workflow's name, compared in code, as a missing check.

edge_cases.case: A name that is neither a workflow nor a required check is still named.

acceptance_criteria.text: The shipped settings declare no plan or work label, the labels that once started agents.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: It reads one fixed file that Dokima ships.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each issue Dokima files carries the filed label under its name in the labels setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: Dokima adds and creates the filed label under its name in the labels setting

edge_cases.case: The repo also holds the old filed label; the issue carries only the renamed one.

acceptance_criteria.text: When the repo lacks the filed label, Dokima creates it under its name in the labels setting.
acceptance_criteria.words: Dokima adds and creates the filed label under its name in the labels setting

edge_cases.case: The repo still holds only the old filed label name.

test_changes.tests/test_settings_merge.py::test_the_s: Owner's #515 drops plan and work labels; every other default still checked.

raises.label: Reading: merge queue
raises.text: With the queue off, should auto-merge need only main's review exemption? The plan assumes so.
raises.evidence: `dokima/audit.py` `auto_merge()` names the queue's bypass list; #375, still open, adds the switch-on ask.

raises.label: Conflict: plan, work labels
raises.text: Your settings list keeps plan and work labels; your #515 note drops them. The plan drops them. Right?
raises.evidence: `dokima/defaults.yaml` `labels` holds plan and work; nothing reads them; #740 row D1 lists them.

answers.why: The owner named the autopilot label as carried by #787; 784.8 and 784.9 now carry the filed label, with tests.
